search_text: published ZDI-14-050 ZDI-CAN-1929 McAfee Cloud Identity Manager ExtensionAccessServlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-04-03 7.8 ['McAfee'] ['Cloud Identity Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of McAfee Cloud Identify Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within a servlet called ExtensionAccessServlet which contains a directory traversal vulnerability inside the path info string of a GET request. A remote attacker can leverage this vulnerability to read arbitrary files from the underlying OS with SYSTEM privileges. McAfee has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
